analysis: This batch contains only documentation and changelog edits: changelog.d/qwen38-mtp-forced-tools.md (new, lines 1-6) and docs/architecture/inference.md (date bump at line 3; new paragraph near head lines 715-719 about required/named tool_choice on Qwen 3.5-family accepting .qwen35 or .xmlFunction parsers, with both Qwen3.8-27B builds advertising forced tools). No Swift source was supplied, so the actual change to ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift (the advertisement of required/named tool_choice for the embedded-MTP Qwen3.8-27B build, and parser acceptance for qwen3_5) is not reviewed here. Another pass should check that change if it exists. Security relevance is low: tool_choice enforcement affects a constrained-decoding/parsing path (TB-007, TB-002), not encryption, attestation, key handling or the prefix cache (T-041). Prompt/tool data handling is unchanged by the docs. Residual question for deeper review: whether widening parser acceptance for forced calls to .qwen35 changes constraint enforcement or output parsing safety, and whether capability advertisement to the coordinator for this model matches real behavior. This cannot be verified from the supplied evidence, so it is recorded as an unverified contract rather than a finding.
